Title: Azure Backup available in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Backup is now available in five new regions, covering all the non-government US regions and Brazil. These new regions are:
  • Central US
  • North Central US
  • South Central US
  • East US2
  • Brazil South
With this new region expansion, Azure Backup is available in 17 regions worldwide. The green dots in the following image are new regions, and the white dots represent the regions where Azure Backup is already available (Australia East, Australia Southeast, East Asia, East US, Japan East, Japan West, North Europe, Southeast Asia, West Europe, West US, North East China, East China). You can learn more about this update from this blog post: Azure Backup is Now Available in Central US, North Central US, South Central US, East US2, Brazil South.
